title: fix(app-shell): zh-CN view properties panel reads the empty filter prompt and the description hint in Chinese

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTf9u99MNcXxBFXXba1TPyn)_

Refs #30039

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：中文控制台下，视图属性面板里筛选框的空白提示从英文「+ Add filter…」改为「+ 添加筛选…」，「描述」一栏的说明文字改为中文。
- 为什么改：#30039 第 5 项浏览器验证时，卡片点名的六个位置里只有视图属性面板还剩这两处英文，其余五处（发布清单、流程问题页、节点面板、通知节点、仪表盘用词）实测已是中文。
- 风险与回滚：只改两处界面文字，英文控制台不变，不动数据和接口。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`（筛选按钮取词）、`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`（视图 `description` 的中文说明）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.filterBuilderHeldRow-26738.test.tsx`，预期全部通过，其中 objectstack#30039 一组断言中文为「+ 添加筛选…」、英文仍为「+ Add filter…」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Browser verification of #30039 (Acceptance 5) on a dev boot of the example CRM with the console in zh-CN found two English strings left at position 1, the view properties panel (`/studio/com.example.crm/interfaces?surface=view:crm_lead.all`). Both are in the card's evidence list for that position:

- **`+ Add filter…`**: the `filter-builder` widget's empty trigger in `widgets.tsx` was an English literal. It now reads `engine.inspector.dataset.addFilter`, the Studio string the dataset scope filter (`FilterConditionField`) already uses for the same button, which has a zh row (`+ 添加筛选…`). The widget already held `locale` from `useMetadataLocale()`.
- **`View description for documentation/tooltips`**: the `description` row's hint was the spec schema's own `.describe()` text, because neither the form nor the platform's zh-CN metadata-forms bundle carries help for it. The zh-CN view overlay (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`) now gives that row `helpText: '视图说明，用于文档与悬停提示'`. The file's header said every leaf is copied from the platform bundle; it now names this kind of hand-worded leaf as the one exception and the row is marked.

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Verification

Boot: full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` at `6f095b9c` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), `examples/app-crm` `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, console Vite pointed at it, Playwright Chromium with `locale: 'zh-CN'`, signed in as the dev admin. For positions 2 to 5 a writable package `com.qa.zhterms` was seeded over the REST door: an object and a record-after-update flow saved active, then five drafts (object label change, flow `status` change, new dataset, dashboard and permission set) with `?mode=draft`. `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` answered the flow `bound: false`, `unboundCause: missing_trigger`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of this card's surface, reported to the seat:** with the view panel's collapsed sections opened (表格选项, 分页, 终端用户控制, 导航与共享), about sixty rows still read English: field hints the form declares no help for (`Enable column resizing`, `Row height / density setting`, …) and every sub-field of the `selection`, `pagination`, `userFilters`, `appearance`, `userActions`, `navigation` and `sharing` composites (labels such as `Page Size`, `Element`, `Allowed Visualizations` and its options, and their hints). None of them is in any catalogue: the platform zh-CN metadata-forms bundle carries only keys the form declares, and the overlay's composite rule forbids naming children the form does not declare (naming one would hide the rest). The lasting fix is upstream: the spec view form declares those sub-fields and hints so the extractor emits keys, the platform bundle translates them, and the overlay copies them. Shot: `30039-p1b-view-panel-expanded-finding.png`.
- The design canvas and the panel header show the view's authored label `All Leads`, while the rail shows the translated 全部线索. Noted, not filed here.
- #30164 (the platform bundle's 仪表板) did not show at any position: the dashboard inspector read 仪表盘 on this boot.
